mesh_surface_measure_audit.verification: Every emitted triangle was checked: its outward-offset centroid is outside all primitives and its inward-offset centroid is inside. Primitive boundary planes partition constant occupancy, so no unrepresented boundary crosses an emitted elementary face.
mesh_surface_measure_audit.sensor_consistency: Scene tests additionally compare primitive sensor first hits with union-mesh hits at front/rear RGB-D fixtures; no sensor backend replacement.
remaining_approximations: reachable visibility lattice rather than all continuous camera poses
